title: The least physical dimension of an inflation-symmetric model set, with the cubic, quartic and degree-12 inflations of x^3 - x - 1 and x^4 - x - 1
summary: Kernel-checked proofs, in Lean 4 + Mathlib, about cut-and-project schemes on a fixed integer lattice Z^iota invariant under an integer matrix A: splittings R^iota = E + H into A-invariant subspaces with Z^iota meeting H only in 0 and the projection of Z^iota to H dense in H, a window W in H (bounded, containing a relative ball), the model set Lambda(W) = {pi_E g : g in Z^iota, pi_H g in W}, and admissibility, some window with A Lambda(W) contained in Lambda(W) (inflation symmetry in Meyer's inclusion sense). The least physical dimension d(A) is the least dim E over admissible schemes.…

review.reason: Lean 4 results on physical dimension of inflation-symmetric cut-and-project model sets.
